departments.name: Health
departments.label: Health
departments.purpose: Due care gets booked, refills never run out, insurer deadlines never slip; the body stays with their doctor.

departments.name: Home
departments.label: Home
departments.purpose: The place they live now stays safe and unsurprising: no surprise lease renewal, no dead alarm, no forgotten repair. A "next home" search is a separate project, not this area.

departments.name: Money
departments.label: Money
departments.purpose: Bills land on time, nothing surprises them, and spare money goes where they decided, not where the loudest deadline points.

departments.name: Paperwork
departments.label: Paperwork
departments.purpose: Taxes, IDs, and legal papers handled before they bite.

departments.name: Pets
departments.label: Pets
departments.purpose: The animals are cared for on time, and someone is ready to step in if the person cannot.

departments.name: Protection
departments.label: Insurance & benefits
departments.purpose: No coverage gaps, no window closes unseen; every account names who the person wants.
